name: lexkite
description: Lexkite – IELTS, TOEIC & TOEFL learning app (web PWA, Chrome extension, iOS/Android)

scripts.test: node scripts/vi-lint.mjs && node scripts/cws-check.mjs && node scripts/i18n-missing.mjs --strict && node scripts/i18n-qa.mjs --strict && node scripts/test/unit.mjs && node scripts/test/smoke.js web && node scripts/test/i18n-leak.js web en,zh,ar --strict && ! node scripts/test/a11y.js web 2>/dev/null | grep -q NOLABEL && node scripts/test/explain-check.mjs && node scripts/test/size-budget.mjs && node scripts/test/infra-check.mjs && node scripts/test/content-check.mjs && node scripts/test/axe.js web && node scripts/test/crawl.js web
